gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-koho: KoHo reads clean and unfussy, its c apertures swung wide open. Shantell Sans sits above it with a hand-drawn, one-nib looseness, and you can nudge KoHo's size up a touch without upsetting it.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-kosugi: Professional and tidy in Kosugi, whose open-jawed c has a wire-bent look, while Shantell Sans above it feels expressive and distinctive. One font plays, the other works.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-kumbh-sans: Shantell Sans has a mouth-wide, fixed-nib look, like marker lettering with a grin. Kumbh Sans follows with short-cut terminals and pen-drawn strokes, so the two feel like a doodle next to a tidy memo.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-lato: Hollow, tube-like letters with a grin. Lato, a plain sans with wide s curves, stays quiet beneath, which lets Shantell Sans earn its keep when it is big and short.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-libre-franklin: Libre Franklin reads clean and businesslike, its splayed c terminal giving each line a small flick of character. Shantell Sans, drawn with a fixed-width nib above it, keeps the page playful, but the text below holds steady and unhurried.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-line-seed-jp: Shantell Sans draws every stroke with one fixed nib and a wide, can-lid mouth, so it looks hand-lettered and lively. And LINE Seed JP, with horizontals as heavy as verticals, grounds the page in an approachable, orderly sans-serif.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-livvic: Livvic reads clean and approachable, with stress-free curves and a generous opening in its c. Shantell Sans does expressive display work best; Livvic does quiet text.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-lunasima: Tubular strokes like bent copper pipe make Shantell Sans instantly recognizable up top. Lunasima, a clean, contemporary sans-serif with c tips that stay well apart, gives the page somewhere quiet to rest.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-lxgw-marker-goth: LXGW Marker Gothic reads contemporary and modest, a wide-open c and a gentle stroke contrast keeping each word light. It stays pleasant for page after page.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-m-plus-1: Loose, wobbly, a little cheeky. M PLUS 1 follows with big open eyes on every e and a, so Shantell Sans handles the personality while the fineliner-flat plain sans handles the reading.
